notes.title: Game Launched!
notes.notes:
Greetings everybody, its Purisic Games, I'm a one man with a big dream becoming true!

I had a dream for quite some time to try and make a game by merging two of my favorite themes: time travel and deck builder roguelikes. The result is this game and that's more than I ever hoped for.

​I am writing to let you know that my game Looping Bravery is launching on September 28th at 9:00am PDT.

My game is a roguelike deck builder about an agent known as The Traveler who is stuck in a time loop (which feels at home in the roguelike genre) trying to save the day by traveling back in time. When I think about my game, I think it's best described as a mix of "Edge of Tomorrow", "Slay the Spire" and "Hades" mechanics.

At the start of every run, you pick two weapons, one offensive and one defensive. On your way to victory you will choose powerful cards and items and use your hard-earned antimatter with your TMD (Time Manipulation Device) to bend the turns to your will.

Engage in dialogues (more than 100 different ones) with enemies that have impacts on the flow of the battle and try to win before the turn counter hits the specified turn!

Hope you like the game everyone. Love you!

notes.title: Looping Bravery Demo at Steam Next Fest June 2022 Second live-stream
notes.notes:
Embark on a time-traveling mission through history to save the humanity from an impending alien invasion.

It will be hard but don't worry, if you die, you will be saved as soon as your heart stops so you can try again and finish the mission. It's a roguelike after all!

Come join my stream and watch me play the demo and explain the mechanics! 

You can download the demo on the steam page and I would like to hear your thoughts as well as how can the game be improved.
